Haste 1.0.0

Archived Android test build · 24 September 2026

Superseded

Haste is an Android test build with local food journaling, hosted Firebase accounts, food search, and optional AI estimates through the Haste API. Review estimates before saving. Journals in previous test packages do not transfer automatically. This build predates the Google Play version (1.2.10) and is kept for reference.

About these files

APKs are public GitHub Release assets, so no GitHub account is needed. Android only: they won’t install on an iPhone or iPad. Installing an older build over a newer one isn’t supported. The SHA-256 above identifies the exact file; it doesn’t verify every feature on every phone.
